tip.zh:
🏠 今日北京阴到转晴，气温约 3~13°C，早间偏冷（实况约 4.5°C、体感约 1°C）；无降水，阵风偏强（模型日最大阵风约 22 km/h），空气不健康（US AQI≈157、PM2.5≈167），出门戴口罩，敏感体质尽量缩短户外暴露。
🏃 训练提醒：今天周五是早上健身日，也是可选跑日之一——与「不健康空气」明显冲突，室外跑建议改室内跑/健身房有氧；健身房室内训练可照常，去程注意防风保暖与口罩。周六起可能雨雪降温（约 1~6°C、降水约 18mm），周日仍偏冷有雪。
📅 未来7天（北京，Open-Meteo；阴晴参考模型 weather_code，空气 Open-Meteo AQ）：
• 11/6 周五 3~13°C 阴转晴，阵风偏强（晨练防风保暖；空气不健康，慎户外跑）
• 11/7 周六 1~6°C 雨雪可能（降水约 18mm）
• 11/8 周日 -2~4°C 雨雪可能（降水约 7mm，偏冷）
• 11/9 周一 -3~7°C 晴
• 11/10 周二 -2~10°C 晴（冬中午跑日，空气待观察）
• 11/11 周三 0~10°C 晴
• 11/12 周四 1~10°C 晴
• 11/13 周五 2~11°C 晴到少云
（气温/降水/风：Open-Meteo 约 08:15 北京时间；空气：Open-Meteo Air Quality）
tip.en:
🏠 Beijing today: overcast easing clearer, ~3–13°C, chilly morning (~4.5°C / feels ~1°C); dry but gusty (~22 km/h) and unhealthy air (US AQI≈157, PM2.5≈167)—mask up; minimize outdoor exposure if sensitive.
🏃 Training: Fri is morning-gym day and an optional-run day—outdoor run conflicts with unhealthy air; prefer indoor/gym cardio. Indoor gym OK; dress windproof + mask on the commute. Sat onward: rain/snow cooldown (~1–6°C, ~18mm), Sun still chilly with more precip risk.
📅 Next 7 days (Beijing, Open-Meteo):
• Fri 11/6 3–13°C overcast→clearer, gusty (gym OK; skip outdoor run—unhealthy air)
• Sat 11/7 1–6°C rain/snow possible (~18mm)
• Sun 11/8 −2–4°C rain/snow possible (~7mm, chilly)
• Mon 11/9 −3–7°C clear
• Tue 11/10 −2–10°C clear (winter noon-run day; check air)
• Wed 11/11 0–10°C clear
• Thu 11/12 1–10°C clear
• Fri 11/13 2–11°C mainly clear
(Temps/precip/wind: Open-Meteo ~08:15 Asia/Shanghai; air: Open-Meteo AQ)

openingSummary.zh: 过去约两日被安全智能体与 Claude 产品能力主导：OpenAI 发布 GPT‑6 Cyber（Daybreak Red；ExploitGym 相对提升约 51%），并延续 Linux 内核自主挖洞/打补丁叙事；同窗 Images 2.6 仍在热推。Claude 在美推出 Personal Finance 只读账户问答 beta（Pro/Max/Ultra）。Cursor changelog 上线 Build Live Apps。论文侧 alphaXiv 热榜仍以 Agent 评测与 agentic RL 居多。缺口：@karpathy / Meta 近 48h 无高信号原创；DeepMind 仅 RT Gemini Omni / TTS；关注列表无 DeepSeek 一手 X。
openingSummary.en: Over ~48h, cyber agents and Claude product features led: OpenAI shipped GPT‑6 Cyber (Daybreak Red; ~51% relative ExploitGym gain) alongside the Linux kernel discovery/patch narrative; Images 2.6 still rolling. Claude launched Personal Finance beta in the US (read-only account Q&A on Pro/Max/Ultra). Cursor changelog added Build Live Apps. alphaXiv Hot stayed Agent/agentic-RL heavy. Gaps: @karpathy / Meta quiet on high-signal originals; DeepMind only RT’d Gemini Omni/TTS; no DeepSeek primary X in the watchlist.

summary.zh: OpenAI 发布 GPT‑6 Cyber：面向授权安全研究的专用模型，宣称相对 GPT‑5.6 Cyber 在 ExploitGym 约 +51%，并强调更守边界；先向部分 Daybreak Red 客户开放，后续扩量，11/12 还有 Cyber livestream。
summary.en: OpenAI introduced GPT‑6 Cyber—a cyber-specialized model for authorized security research, claiming ~51% relative ExploitGym gain vs GPT‑5.6 Cyber with stronger in-scope alignment; rolling to select Daybreak Red customers, with a Nov 12 Cyber livestream.

caption.zh: GPT‑6 Cyber 发布视频封面（来源：@OpenAI）
Cyber at the Frontier 直播预告封面（来源：@OpenAI）
caption.en: Cyber at the Frontier livestream card (source: @OpenAI)

summary.zh: Claude 推出 Personal Finance（美国 beta）：只读连接用户自选账户，用日常语言回答余额/账单类问题，不能转账或投资；逐步面向 Pro/Max/Ultra，无广告与赞助推荐。
summary.en: Claude launched Personal Finance (US beta): read-only links to accounts you choose, answers money questions in plain language, can’t move/invest funds; rolling on Pro/Max/Ultra with no ads or sponsored tips.

caption.zh: Personal Finance 发布视频封面（来源：@claudeai）

summary.zh: ChatGPT Images 2.6 上线：支持 GIF 与参考图；API 新增 GPT-Image-2.6 Flare / Sunburst，宣称图像生成约快 50%；全订阅档 ChatGPT/Codex 可用。
summary.en: ChatGPT Images 2.6 live—GIFs + reference images; API adds GPT-Image-2.6 Flare/Sunburst with ~50% faster image gen claimed; across ChatGPT/Codex tiers.

caption.zh: GPT-Image-2.6 Flare / Sunburst 配图（来源：@OpenAI）

summary.zh: Anthropic：生物学团队与 Claude 合作，首次解析细菌/噬菌体来源 Vault（穹窿）颗粒 3D 结构，并讨论 AI 加速科学中的失误与协作。
summary.en: Anthropic: biology team with Claude mapped the first 3D vault particle from bacterial/phage life, with notes on AI speedups, mistakes, and collaboration.

caption.zh: Vault 研究动图封面（来源：@AnthropicAI）

summary.zh: Codex/ChatGPT 产品侧：强调最新 cyber 专用模型在多项安全场景「自成一档」，经 Daybreak Red 提供；另称 ChatGPT+API 图像周生成已超 40 亿张。
summary.en: Codex/ChatGPT product voice: said the latest cyber-specialized model is in its own league on many cyber cases via Daybreak Red; also noted >4B images/week across ChatGPT+API.

summary.zh: Andrew Ng：预热 AI Dev（纽约，11/30–12/1），议程含 coding agents / harness、Agent memory、生产可观测；并与 Yann LeCun 谈 world models。
summary.en: Andrew Ng plugged AI Dev NYC (Nov 30–Dec 1)—sessions on coding agents/harness, agent memory, production evals—plus a world-models talk with Yann LeCun.

summary.zh: DeepMind 近 48h 无原创高信号帖，仅 RT Google AI Studio：Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash 上线（更快、宣称约降价 30%）。
summary.en: DeepMind had no high-signal originals in ~48h—only RT’d Google AI Studio’s Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash (faster, ~30% lower cost claimed).

title.zh: GPT‑6 Cyber：对齐更好的网络安全智能体前沿
title.en: GPT‑6 Cyber: Advancing the frontier of aligned cybersecurity agents

summary.zh: 11/5：面向授权挖洞/验证的专用模型；ExploitGym 48.5%（相对 GPT‑5.6 Cyber 提升约 51%），越界率显著下降；先经 Daybreak Red API/Codex 对部分客户开放。
summary.en: Nov 5: cyber-specialized model for authorized vuln find/validate; ExploitGym 48.5% (~51% relative vs GPT‑5.6 Cyber) with much better in-scope behavior; initial Daybreak Red API/Codex access.

title.zh: Introducing Images 2.6：更快生成与更可控编辑

summary.zh: 11/4：ChatGPT/Codex/API 上线 Images 2.6——GIF、参考图、图像标注与 SVG（API）；Flare/Sunburst 两档模型。
summary.en: Nov 4: Images 2.6 on ChatGPT/Codex/API—GIFs, reference images, markup, SVG (API); Flare/Sunburst models.

summary.zh: 11/5：美国 Pro/Max/Ultra beta——只读连接银行/卡片账户，用自然语言汇总开支与余额；不能转账或给出投资建议，无广告。
summary.en: Nov 5: US Pro/Max/Ultra beta—read-only bank/card links, plain-language spending/balance answers; can’t move money or give investment advice; no ads.

title.zh: A thousand fewer paths to root：Linux 本地提权流水线
title.en: A thousand fewer paths to root

summary.zh: 11/4：自主挖洞—利用—打补丁流水线，一次运行验证并为 948 个 Linux 本地提权漏洞生成补丁（API 成本约 $1.2M）；与 GPT‑6 Cyber 叙事衔接。
summary.en: Nov 4: autonomous discovery–exploit–patch pipeline validated/patched 948 Linux LPE vulns in one run (~$1.2M API cost); ties into the GPT‑6 Cyber narrative.

alphaxivTop3.title: FrontierPhysics: Evaluating Agents for End-to-End Physics Research
alphaxivTop3.authors: BenchFlow / UC Berkeley / Caltech / Harvard / Stanford et al.

summary.zh: （Agent 优先）alphaXiv Hot #2（约 11/4）：面向端到端物理研究智能体的评测基准，覆盖从问题提出到实验/分析的完整链条（作者页标注 Trending）。
summary.en: (Agent pick) alphaXiv Hot #2 (~Nov 4): benchmark for end-to-end physics-research agents spanning problem formulation through experiment/analysis (author page marks Trending).

alphaxivTop3.title: Stabilizing On-Policy Targeted Guidance in Agentic Reinforcement Learning
alphaxivTop3.authors: Kevin Frans, Alexander M Rush, Sergey Levine, Pieter Abbeel (Cursor / UC Berkeley)

summary.zh: （Agent 优先）Hot 前列（约 11/3）：多轮软件工程智能体的 targeted guidance——失败回合插入文本提示，用 on-policy self-distillation 学难优化行为，同时尽量不伤基线 coding pass（作者自报）。
summary.en: (Agent pick) trending (~Nov 3): targeted guidance for multi-turn SWE agents—inject textual hints on failing turns via on-policy self-distillation without degrading baseline coding pass (author-reported).

alphaxivTop3.title: Adversarial Speculative Reasoning Improves Long Horizon Agents
alphaxivTop3.authors: Hongyin Luo, Wei Fang, Dana Wensberg, Jack O'Brien, et al.

summary.zh: （Agent 优先）Hot #6（约 11/3）：把 speculative decoding 从纯加速改成关键决策点的上下文精度分配——训练 draft 在关键处被拒绝，使关键推理落在更干净的验证槽（作者自报长程 coding agent 增益）。
summary.en: (Agent pick) Hot #6 (~Nov 3): recasts speculative decoding as a context-precision allocator at critical decisions—train the draft to be rejected so key tokens land in cleaner verify slots; reported long-horizon coding-agent gains (author-reported).

summary.zh: 新稳定版 v0.23.0「The Hearth Release」（2026-11-05）：Desktop 工作区可在浏览器由本机 gateway 打开；会话统一由单一 gateway 托管（CLI/TUI/Desktop/编辑器/机器人/cron 同桌）；插件目录扩至 1000+、可自更新；付费 MCP 工具可标价与限额；终端内联图片与对话 rewind。
summary.en: New stable v0.23.0 “The Hearth Release” (2026-11-05): Desktop workspace opens in-browser via your gateway; one gateway owns each session across CLI/TUI/Desktop/editors/bots/cron; plugin catalog 1000+ with self-updates; priced/limited paid MCP tools; inline terminal images + conversation rewind.

summary.zh: 新版 v2026.11.1（2026-11-05）：更安全的 Mac 设置写入、频道回复更稳（Telegram/Discord/webhook）、中断后会话可续、更新恢复与 Windows Gateway 修复、subagent 跟进更可靠。另有 v2026.11.5-beta.1（11/4）预发布线。
summary.en: New v2026.11.1 (2026-11-05): safer Mac settings writes, more reliable channel replies (Telegram/Discord/webhook), better interrupt recovery, updater/Windows Gateway fixes, sturdier subagent follow-ups. Also v2026.11.5-beta.1 (Nov 4) on the prerelease line.

summary.zh: 实验线仍为 dsh-v0.2.2-rc.1（2026-11-04）：0.2.2 首个 RC——手机/平板适配、引用插入、历史导出 Markdown、实验性 subagent_oar（交给本机 Codex/Claude CLI）、变更请求与工作树审查等。关注列表无 DeepSeek 一手 X；本日未见更新标签。
summary.en: Experimental line still dsh-v0.2.2-rc.1 (2026-11-04): first 0.2.2 RC with mobile/tablet polish, quote-to-input, Markdown history export, experimental subagent_oar (hand off to local Codex/Claude CLI), change-request/worktree review. No DeepSeek primary X; no newer tag today.

summary.zh: 稳定版仍为 rust-v0.166.0（2026-10-29）。预发布线已推到 rust-v0.168.0-alpha.7（2026-11-05，说明极简）；同窗口还有 alpha.1–6 与 0.167 系列。产品侧 GPT‑6 Cyber / Images 2.6 已接入 Codex 叙事（见技术动态）。
summary.en: Stable still rust-v0.166.0 (2026-10-29). Prerelease advanced to rust-v0.168.0-alpha.7 (2026-11-05, minimal notes); same window also saw alpha.1–6 and 0.167.x. Product-side: GPT‑6 Cyber / Images 2.6 land in Codex narratives (see tech section).

summary.zh: 11/5 产品更新：Personal Finance 美国 beta（Pro/Max/Ultra）——只读账户连接与自然语言理财问答，无广告、不能动账。新闻室「Latest」日期条显示 11/6，featured 仍多为既有公告；Vault 生物学研究（11/4）与 FlashProve（11/3）仍属近期相邻研究。
summary.en: Nov 5 product update: Personal Finance US beta (Pro/Max/Ultra)—read-only account linking and plain-language money Q&A; no ads; can’t move funds. Newsroom Latest date bar shows Nov 6 while featured remains prior announcements; vault biology (Nov 4) and FlashProve (Nov 3) remain adjacent research.

summary.zh: changelog 新条目 2026-11-05：Build Live Apps——用 Cloud Agent 描述需求即可脚手架 Web 应用、按需起 Postgres、Cursor SSO 鉴权并部署，分享组织内可用链接（Origin/GitHub；GitLab 随后）。此前最近一条仍为 10/20 Agent SDK GA。
summary.en: New changelog entry 2026-11-05: Build Live Apps—describe an app to a Cloud Agent; Cursor scaffolds the web app, optional Postgres, Cursor SSO auth, and hosting with a shareable org link (Origin/GitHub; GitLab soon). Prior latest remained Oct 20 Agent SDK GA.

summary.zh: 本日成功抓取官方 changelog：Latest 仍为 v0.78.1（2026-10-27）——购物卡片、「立即购买」、Vault Shop Pay、订阅模板、自定义模式下的云端智能体、团队 Bot Vault。注：changelog 常滞后客户端；本日未能从官方渠道确认客户端实际版本号高于页面 Latest，故不写「近几日无新版本」。
summary.en: Official changelog fetched today: Latest still v0.78.1 (2026-10-27)—shopping cards, Buy now, Shop Pay in Vault, subscription templates, cloud agents in custom modes, Team Bot Vault. Changelog often lags the client; client build not confirmed above page Latest today, so not claiming no recent builds.

summary.en: Fri pre-open ~08:22 Asia/Shanghai still shows Thu close: HK$31.300, +8.83% (+2.540) on ~490.5M shares / ~HK$15.14B; range 29.62–31.40, open 30.00. Live quote after 09:30 HKT open. Source: Tencent HK quote + daily K (matches Sina). 52-week ~HK$21.30–44.62.

highlights.en: Thu closed nearly +9% on heavy volume; watch elevated volatility and post-open mean reversion.

highlights.en: Auto-delivery narrative remains in play; next earnings catalyst remains Q3 results on Nov 24.

text.zh: 今日重心（周五去敏）：推进主要功能迁移情况梳理（含声纹等模块进度与整体汇报准备）；复核云端缺陷密度计算；继续 harness 工程课与技术文章日更；穿插安全架构信任边界学习与 RSI 拆解；通识阅读并行。
text.en: Friday focus (sanitized): advance main feature-migration status review (incl. voiceprint-module progress and overall readout prep); recheck cloud defect-density metrics; continue harness-engineering course and daily tech reading; interleaved security-architecture trust-boundary study and RSI teardown; parallel general reading.
